binaries.name: esedbexport
binaries.why: Read the ESE databases Windows keeps: WebCacheV01.dat for browsing, SRUDB.dat for application and network use.

binaries.name: yara
binaries.why: Sweep an extract or a directory against rules and report every match with its offset.

binaries.name: strings
binaries.why: First pass over a binary before a parser is chosen.

binaries.name: vshadowinfo
binaries.why: List the volume shadow copies on an image, with each store's creation time: the volume as it was before a cleanup.

binaries.name: vshadowmount
binaries.why: Expose a shadow copy as a volume the ordinary toolkit can list and extract from. Needs FUSE on the host.

binaries.name: vol
binaries.why: Memory analysis, when the host has it. Not shipped with this pack: the Volatility Software License and AGPL-3.0 do not combine in one work, so it is invoked as an executable or not at all.

binaries.name: fsntfsinfo
binaries.why: Read $MFT, named streams and the USN journal with an independent parser: a finding two parsers agree on survives review that one does not.

binaries.name: sccainfo
binaries.why: An independent read of a prefetch file, compressed or not, to check prefetch_mam against.

binaries.name: fwsiinfo
binaries.why: Decode a shell item from its documented layout, which is what shellbags falls back to searching for.

binaries.name: olecfexport
binaries.why: Take a jump list apart as the compound file it is.

binaries.name: lnkinfo
binaries.why: An independent read of a link file's target, volume serial and timestamps.

binaries.name: regfexport
binaries.why: Export a registry hive with a parser that is not regipy.

binaries.name: evtxexport
binaries.why: Export event records with a parser that is not python-evtx.

binaries.name: msiecfexport
binaries.why: Read an Internet Explorer index.dat cache, which no other tool here covers.

binaries.name: pffexport
binaries.why: Read a PST or OST mailbox: the mail on a Windows machine, which nothing else in this pack touches.

binaries.name: memprocfs
binaries.why: Mount a memory image as a file system: processes, handles, registry and network state as files. AGPL-3.0, so unlike Volatility its licence and this project's do combine.

binaries.name: zircolite
binaries.why: Run thousands of Sigma rules over EVTX and return the detections. The fastest of the three engines and the lightest on memory.

binaries.name: hayabusa
binaries.why: Sigma detections plus a forensic timeline over EVTX, in one Rust binary.

binaries.name: MFTECmd
binaries.why: The $MFT, $J, $Boot and $SDS parser most reports cite. Needs the .NET runtime; MIT licensed.

binaries.name: EvtxECmd
binaries.why: Event log parser with maps that normalise the payload differences between event ids. Needs the .NET runtime.

binaries.name: RECmd
binaries.why: Registry hive search and export with batch files for whole artefact families. Needs the .NET runtime.

binaries.name: rip
binaries.why: Hundreds of registry plugins, each written for one question. Perl; invoked as an executable.
